CustomField.description: Record type applied to Cases created from this section's related records during conversion. Read in Form_Submission_Convert_Process_Case_Overridable as the section's own value, resolved from developer name to a RecordType; a blank leaves RecordTypeId unset so Salesforce assigns the converting user's default Case record type. The section never inherits the Form Template's Case Record Type.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick the record type for Cases this section creates. Leave blank to use the converting user's default Case record type.
CustomField.label: Case (Record Type)
